title: Sparkly watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE066'>
    <path d='M18 20 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2z'/>
    <path d='M82 14 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M75 70 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M22 75 l1 3 l3 1 l-3 1 l-1 3 l-1 -3 l-3 -1 l3 -1z'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='42' r='2' fill='#FFF3A0'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#FFF3A0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Can body -->
  <rect x='30' y='45' width='40' height='32' rx='5' fill='#E85D75'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <rect x='34' y='49' width='8' height='24' rx='3' fill='#F490A1'/>
  <!-- Bottom rim -->
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='40' height='5' rx='2' fill='#C23A52'/>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d='M42 45 Q42 28 55 28 Q68 28 68 45' fill='none' stroke='#C23A52' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 45 Q42 30 55 30 Q68 30 68 45' fill='none' stroke='#F490A1' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d='M30 55 L10 40 L8 46 L30 62 Z' fill='#E85D75'/>
  <!-- Spout highlight -->
  <path d='M29 57 L12 43' stroke='#F490A1' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Spout top edge -->
  <path d='M10 40 L8 46' stroke='#C23A52' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Rose (sprinkler head) -->
  <ellipse cx='9' cy='43' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#7BC96F' transform='rotate(-40 9 43)'/>
  <circle cx='7' cy='40' r='1' fill='#B8F0A0'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='42' r='1' fill='#B8F0A0'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='45' r='1' fill='#B8F0A0'/>
  <circle cx='11' cy='46' r='1' fill='#B8F0A0'/>
</svg>
